question: __________ has been invited as the chief guest for India's Republic Day celebrations 2023, marking the first time for this nation's President to receive this honour.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abdel Fattah EL-Sisi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Egypt's President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi **was invited as the chief guest for India's 2023 Republic Day celebrations.
 
• [IMAGE: https://www.thestatesman.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/President-Droupadi-Murmu-accorded-a-ceremonial-welcome-to-President-Abdel-Fattah-El-Sisi-of-Egypt-at-Rashtrapati-Bhavan-scaled.jpg] 
 
• It was the first time that an** Egyptian President** had been invited as the chief guest for this significant event.
 
• The invitation signifies the strengthening of India-Egypt diplomatic relations, particularly in the fields of defense, security, and trade.
 
• Inviting foreign dignitaries as chief guests on **Republic Day** is a tradition in India, symbolizing bilateral ties with the guest's country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Russian President Vladimir Putin** has a longstanding relationship with India, and Russia-India relations are particularly strong in the defense and energy sectors. 
 
• Former German Chancellor **Angela Merkel **has been a key figure in EU-India relations, particularly in trade and technology.
 
• **Xi Jinping** is the General Secretary of the Communist Party of China and the **President of the People's Republic of China**, leading the country since 2013
 
• The selection of the Republic Day chief guest often reflects **India's strategic priorities**, focusing on fostering stronger ties in defense, trade, and diplomacy.
 
• Inviting foreign leaders also showcases India's emphasis on cultural diplomacy, highlighting historical and contemporary links between India and the guest's country.
